item.text: {"rule":"The first two tapped cards were either discarded or kept, as stated in each round. When they were discarded, the final card was the untapped one of the remaining pair; when they were kept, the final card was the one selected to remain. The observations do not reveal a single consistent procedure for determining the final card."}
